entities.name: José Kelvin de la Nieve
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Kelvin de la Nieve Linares is a boxer. Born in the Dominican Republic, he represents Spain internationally. He competed in the light flyweight weight class at the 2008 and 2012 Summer Olympics.
